description: This file defines the IDurableStateMachine interface, which specifies methods for persisting and recovering state in a durable storage system, including methods for resetting, applying log entries, taking snapshots, and creating deep copies.

classes.name: IDurableStateMachine
classes.description: Interface for a durable state machine with methods for state management, recovery, and snapshotting.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the state machine, clearing volatile state, can be called during recovery.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry or snapshot during recovery.

methods.name: OnRecoveryCompleted
methods.description: Notifies that all prior log entries and snapshots have been applied; called before new entries or snapshots are appended.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Writes pending state changes to the log.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: Writes a snapshot of the current state to the provided writer.

methods.name: OnWriteCompleted
methods.description: Notifies that all prior log entries and snapshots have been written to stable storage.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of the state machine instance.
